name: Work Day Hours Report
query:
SELECT
    z.`date`,
    z.`employee`,
    MAX(z.`employee_name`) as `employee_name`,
    SEC_TO_TIME(SUM(z.`seconds`)) as `total_work_hour`,
    CASE
        WHEN MIN(z.`seconds`) <= 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END as `missed_punch`
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            tmp.`ymd` as `date`,
            tmp.`employee`,
            MAX(tmp.`employee_name`) as `employee_name`,
            MAX(tmp.`punch_unix`) - MIN(tmp.`punch_unix`) as `seconds`
        FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    pd.`employee`,
                    pd.`employee_name`,
                    DATE_FORMAT(pd.`time`, '%%Y-%%m-%%d') as `ymd`,
                    CEILING(
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY pd.`employee`,
                            DATE_FORMAT(pd.`time`, '%%Y-%%m-%%d')
                            ORDER BY
                                pd.`time`
                        ) / 2
                    ) as `seq`,
                    pd.`docstatus`,
                    UNIX_TIMESTAMP(pd.`time`) as `punch_unix`
                FROM
                    `tabEmployee Checkin` pd
                WHERE
                    pd.`docstatus` = 0
            ) tmp
        GROUP BY
            tmp.`ymd`,
            tmp.`employee`,
            tmp.`seq`
    ) z
GROUP BY
    z.`date`,
    z.`employee`
ORDER BY
    z.`date`,
    `employee_name`,
    z.`employee`
